correctness.rationale: Galashin mixed convex connected proper tubes in the height-two ordinal sum are exactly mixed nontrivial subsets, and disjoint tubes form a prohibited directed 2-cycle. Thus all tubings are strict mixed-subset chains. Missing nonadjacent ranks give 4 completions, internal adjacent ranks give 6, while missing ranks 2 and 3 give 2ab completions on a mixed 4-set, hence 6 or 8. Counting subchains and completions proves all formulas and the absence of any other polygon. A 2-plane type-A root subsystem has <=6 directed edge rays, excluding generalized permutohedra when F8>0. Independently reconstructed chain enumeration for all 18 ordered p,q with 4<=p+q<=7, matching closed counts; inspected actual verify.py and RESULT.md; all-n theorem rests on combinatorial proof.
residual_risks: Specialized to height-two complete bipartite posets, not all posets.
Counts polygon combinatorial types, not Euclidean shape/area.
No claim that octagons themselves were previously unknown in every type of polytope.

value.rationale: Two-face polygon spectrum and exact octagon multiplicity refine known f-vectors of a natural, widely studied all-size poset-associahedron family. They distinguish an entire family from generalized permutohedra and are independently useful exact face-lattice invariants, not arbitrarily chosen small cases.
